model.transformation.fct_regular_season_.name: fct_regular_season_games
model.transformation.fct_regular_season_.description: Table de faits des matchs de saison régulière. 107k+ matchs, 1998–2019. Inclut scores, lieu, prolongations et box score détaillé (nullable, disponible depuis 2010).
model.transformation.fct_regular_season_.rawCode:
with compact as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_regular_season_compact_results') }}
),
detailed as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_regular_season_detailed_results') }}
),
game_cities as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_game_cities') }}
),
seasons as (
    select season, day_zero from {{ ref('stg_seasons') }}
),
enriched as (
    select
        -- identifiant
        cast(c.season as varchar) || '_' || cast(c.day_num as varchar) || '_' || cast(c.w_team_id as varchar) || '_' || cast(c.l_team_id as varchar) as game_id,
        'Regular'                                                                               as game_type,

        -- calendrier
        c.season,
        c.day_num,
        (s.day_zero + interval (c.day_num) days)::date                                         as game_date,

        -- équipes
        c.w_team_id,
        c.l_team_id,

        -- scores
        c.w_score,
        c.l_score,
        c.w_score - c.l_score                                                                   as score_margin,
        c.w_score + c.l_score                                                                   as total_points,

        -- lieu
        c.w_loc,
        case c.w_loc
            when 'H' then 'Home'
            when 'A' then 'Away'
            else          'Neutral'
        end                                                                                     as game_location,

        -- overtime
        c.num_ot,

    select
        g.season,

        1                                      as is_win,
        g.w_score                              as pts_scored,
        g.l_score                              as pts_allowed,

            when a.tourney_wins = 4 then 'Final Four'
            when a.tourney_wins = 3 then 'Elite Eight'
            when a.tourney_wins = 2 then 'Sweet Sixteen'
            when a.tourney_wins = 1 then 'Second Round'

        a.avg_pts_allowed,
        a.avg_pt_diff,

        a.avg_fgm,
        a.avg_fga,
        a.fg_pct,
        a.avg_fgm3,
        a.avg_fga3,
        a.fg3_pct,
        a.avg_ftm,
        a.avg_fta,

        a.avg_reb,

        a.avg_def_reb,
        a.avg_ast,

        a.avg_stl,
        a.avg_blk,
        a.avg_pf
    from aggregated a

    left join seasons       s  on a.season  = s.season
    left join tourney_seeds ts on a.season  = ts.season and a.team_id = ts.team_id
)
